findings.evidence_quote: ISO 4914 format; 12-character code, validated against the Derivatives Service Bureau (DSB) UPI reference data.
findings.reasoning: ASIC specifies the field 'Unique product identifier (UPI)' to identify OTC derivative products across asset classes, including commodity derivatives. The field format is explicitly defined as a 12-character code conforming to ISO 4914. Therefore, the requirement is fully accommodated with no conflict.
